policy: High and critical npm audit advisories fail check:supply-chain unless waived here. Every waiver names an owner, a reason and an expiry at most 90 days ahead; devOnly waivers fail if the advisory reaches runtime dependencies. Waivers require independent security review.

waivers.reason: No patched braces exists (latest 3.0.3 is in range <=3.0.3). Reached only through development tooling: shadcn CLI and eslint-config-next via fast-glob and micromatch, which expand repository-authored glob patterns, never request input. npm audit's suggested fixes are major downgrades. Re-evaluate on expiry or when a patched release ships.
